## Cloud Run Request Spike (>300 requests/min for 2m)

One of the Gen2 Cloud Functions (`concierge`, `cloudcredit`, `y2kcardhunt`, or `y2kcardhuntpreview`) is receiving sustained high traffic.

### Immediate Triage
1. Check Cloud Run metrics/logs for the affected `service_name`.
2. Confirm whether traffic is legitimate Campus Warsaw attendee burst (~300 attendees) or bot/abuse traffic.
3. If `concierge` is being abused, activate the graceful kill-switch (`CONCIERGE_ENABLED=false` or `CONCIERGE_LIVE_TOKEN_ENABLED=false`) per `docs/gcp-security-billing-hardening.md`.
4. If volumetric abuse persists, revoke `allUsers` `roles/run.invoker` on the targeted service.
